name: Festapp Tickets
changelog:
= 1.0.3 =
* Import the server-confirmed cookie choice configuration from Festapp. Only the extension’s own form links participate; manual links remain unchanged.
upgrade_notice: Configure and confirm your website in Festapp, then explicitly import its JSON export. Transfer stays off until enabled. No manual scope IDs or revisions are required.
documentation:
Website integration guide: https://tickets.festapp.net/help/embed/
WordPress setup: Settings > Festapp Tickets
Organizer help: https://tickets.festapp.net/help/
Service and organizer pricing: https://tickets.festapp.net/
Support: https://tickets.festapp.net/support/
installation: In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, select the Festapp Tickets plugin ZIP, click Install Now and activate the plugin.
